value.title: Human interface — human-first output, the tui verb, and the daemon event stream
value.summary: Promote the human-render POC as the default output (TTY→human, piped→JSON, --json anywhere), add a ratatui flowspace3 tui verb, and build the status --watch NDJSON event stream both interfaces need.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Jordan's rulings (2026-08-28): 'let's default to human output, with --json available' (interpreted per skunk's asserted TTY strategy: TTY→human, non-TTY/piped→JSON so agents keep parsing, --json forces JSON anywhere, --human forces the renderer) and the TUI POC verdict accepted ('ship a modest ratatui tui verb, defer React'). Three proven inputs: pocs/human-render (committed — rich renderer over frozen envelopes for search/doctor/error/status, TTY strategy, LEARNINGS.md carries its own promotion shape), scratch/tui-poc (mammoth-ox — 4-pane dashboard against real CLI data, VERDICT.md), and the measured gap both share: NO EVENT STREAM (DL-045 — activity must be mocked from poll deltas; any future web UI hits the same wall). Third pij-team pipeline run.

sections.name: goals
value: A human running flowspace3 in a terminal sees beautiful output by default on every verb; agents and pipes keep getting the frozen JSON envelope untouched.
flowspace3 tui ships as a modest, gorgeous ratatui dashboard: roots, live operations, activity, search.
The daemon exposes a real event stream (status --watch NDJSON) so no interface ever mocks activity again.
Agent-path integrity: every doc/skill that tells agents how to call flowspace3 is updated for the new default.

sections.name: non_goals
value: React/web frontend (explicitly deferred by the TUI POC verdict ruling).
Clickable/hyperlinked addresses in the TUI beyond what terminal OSC links give for free.
Renderer coverage of every future verb — the promotion covers the POC's four plus status/add/get/tree; stragglers degrade to JSON honestly.

value.claim: In a TTY every covered verb renders human output; the same invocation piped emits byte-stable frozen JSON; --json forces JSON in a TTY and --human forces the renderer when piped — all four cases asserted by tests.
The JSON envelope is UNCHANGED for agents: existing envelope tests pass unmodified, and the piped output of every covered verb is byte-identical to pre-plan main for identical store state.
flowspace3 tui runs against the live daemon showing roots, queue operations with history, a REAL activity feed (no mock tag anywhere), and in-pane search — over ssh in a plain terminal.
flowspace3 status --watch emits NDJSON events (queue transitions, scan/enrich completions, root changes) consumed by the tui's activity pane; a second concurrent watcher receives the same events.
Agent-path docs updated in the same PR: CLAUDE.md, the flowspace skill, agents-start-here, and the self-teaching CLI guidance all state the TTY rule and --json explicitly.
harness checks green on the composed branch; new dependency edges are impl-guide-granted allowlist rows only.

value.title: Phase 1: Output-mode contract + renderer promotion seams
value.brief: Freeze the seams (PM-solo): the output-mode resolution rule (TTY detect, --json/--human flags, FS3_OUTPUT env override for harnesses that need determinism) as ONE core decision function; the Renderer trait/entry the CLI calls with an envelope; the event-stream wire contract for --watch (NDJSON record shapes, versioned); goldens: pocs/human-render fixtures adopted + piped-byte-stability fixtures captured from current main. The POC's LEARNINGS.md promotion shape is the authoritative input.

value.title: Phase 2: Three parallel units
value.brief: u-r renderer promotion (port pocs/human-render into the CLI behind the phase-1 seam, cover search/doctor/error/status/add/get/tree/remove; agent-path doc updates ride here) · u-w the daemon event stream (status --watch NDJSON per the frozen wire contract; daemon-side event emission at the points work completes) · u-t the tui verb (ratatui per the POC, consuming the CLI JSON surface + the --watch stream; POC code is reference, product code is fresh in-crate). Worktree-per-coder, assumptions sections, absolute paths, snap-in recipes.

value.title: Phase 3: Composition + first light
value.brief: PM composes (ask-assumptions first), gate green, then first light: one terminal session transcript — human-default output on the core verbs, piped JSON byte-check, then tui live against the real daemon with the real event stream while a scan runs. Reviewer (settings default) after composition; PR held unmerged.
